tools.name: bw_system_status
tools.description: Report MCP server status: current environment profile (name, baseUrl, username, client, language, readOnly), whether a live BW session exists for it, all configured profiles, and workdir for file buffering. No network call. Use this first to confirm the server is wired to the right BW system.

tools.name: bw_env_list
tools.description: List configured BW environment profiles and which one is active. Each profile includes name, baseUrl, username, client, language, and readOnly. No network call. Prefer this (or bw_system_status) before bw_env_switch.

tools.name: bw_env_switch
tools.description: Switch the active BW environment profile (e.g. test → prod). Subsequent tools use the new profile. Does not log in until the next tool that needs a client; existing sessions for other profiles are kept. When switching to/from a read-only profile, mutating tools are hidden/shown and a tools/list_changed notification is sent (host support varies; mutating calls are always rejected on read-only profiles).

env.description: Profile name from BW_PROFILES, e.g. "test" or "prod". Use bw_env_list to see options.

tools.name: bw_system_info
tools.description: Query BW system info and capabilities for the current environment (auto-logs in on first call). Use outputPath for the full document. For a single property or capability check, read the returned document (or buffered file) rather than separate tools.

outputPath.description: If provided, the full result is written to this path (under the workdir) and the tool returns only a small summary envelope { ok, outputPath, bytes, summary }. Objects/arrays are written as JSON; ONLY the bw_*_get_xml family writes the raw XML string as plain text (that file is directly reusable as xmlPath in a later save call). Other *_get tools (e.g. bw_dtp_get, bw_trfn_get) write the PARSED XML-to-JSON tree, not raw XML — use the matching bw_*_get_xml tool when you need the raw XML string. Use outputPath for large responses (XML, table data, logs, dataflow graphs). When set, tools skip inline pagination/projection so the file contains the complete payload.

tools.name: bw_disconnect
tools.description: Drop the current environment's BW session/client so the next call reconnects. Other profiles' sessions are left intact. Useful after errors or to force a fresh login.

tools.name: bw_dumps
tools.description: Retrieves ABAP runtime dumps (ST22 feed). Each dump returns title, author, updated, categories and the key troubleshooting sections extracted from the dump HTML (header key/values, where terminated, error analysis, source extract with the crash line, call stack) instead of the full escaped HTML body. Optional query is a plain ADT URL query string, e.g. "maxNumber=5" or "from=20260901120000" (YYYYMMDDhhmmss). Use outputPath for large result sets.

tools.name: bw_adso_add_field
tools.description: Atomic edit: add a field to an ADSO and save (activate optional via autoActivate, default true). Two modes: (1) local field — pass dataType (CUKY emits currency shape; CURR→KYF/SUM); (2) InfoObject hang — pass infoObjectName (keep/inlineType/associationType; UNI needs infoObjectType=UNI or baseInfoObjectName; KYF needs unitCurrencyElement). Prefer currency IOBJ first, then amount. Replace local→IOBJ: hang new, re-point unitCurrencyElement, bw_adso_remove_field old local. success=save/activate; activated only means activation was attempted.

name.description: Field technical name on the ADSO (may differ from infoObjectName).

infoObjectName.description: Hang an existing InfoObject. Emits hang skeleton for UNI/KYF.

infoObjectType.description: Hang type. Omit: unitCurrencyElement→KYF; baseInfoObjectName/CUKY→UNI; else CHA. Pass UNI when hanging a currency IOBJ so dim stays UNI.

dataType.description: Local field DDIC type. Ignored when infoObjectName is set (except CUKY hint→UNI).

dimension.description: Short (CHA/UNI/KYF) or full (#///UNI§). Defaults: UNI hang→UNI, KYF hang→KYF, else inherit/CHA.

unitCurrencyElement.description: Currency/unit field name on this ADSO to bind (e.g. ZC_RWCUR or #///ZC_RWCUR). Use when adding an amount (local CURR or KYF IOBJ hang).

aggregationBehavior.description: Aggregation; KYF/CURR defaults SUM; UNI hang defaults NONE.

outputPath.description: If provided, the full result is written to this path (under the workdir) and the tool returns only a small summary envelope { ok, outputPath, bytes, summary }. tools.name: bw_adso_create
tools.description: Create an empty ADSO shell (fields are added afterwards via bw_adso_add_field and bw_adso_add_key, or by editing the XML from bw_adso_get_xml). Required: name, description, infoArea. Use adsoType to pick the table layout; type-specific options ride along (standard.* / staging.*) and their constraints are validated BEFORE any server call. Pass packageName (e.g. "ZBW") TOGETHER WITH transport=<TRKORR> to create the object in a real package and register it in that workbench request; omitting transport makes the object local to $TMP and it will NOT appear in E071.

name.description: ADSO technical name. 3-9 characters, excluding any /namespace/ prefix (e.g. /CPMB/A2IA1MG is valid: its last segment is 8 chars). InfoArea names have no such limit. Server-side validation rejects violations.

adsoType.description: ADSO type — each type is a different TABLE LAYOUT, and its options are a fixed semantic package (not free booleans): standard = AQ→AT→(optional) changelog; options writeChangeLog/snapshotSupport/uniqueDataRecords (snapshot needs writeChangeLog and excludes uniqueDataRecords; server rejects otherwise); staging = landing buffer, no activation loop; mode is a SINGLE-SELECT template (inboundQueueOnly | compressDataLog | corporateMemory); dataMart = read-only reporting with HANA model; directUpdate = direct write to active data (activation/changelog auto-disabled).

writeChangeLog.description: Write CL mirror for downstream delta extraction. Default true. Off = pure endpoint storage (no delta feed). Required for snapshotSupport.

snapshotSupport.description: Point-in-time snapshot semantics (inventory/non-cumulative). Requires writeChangeLog=true; mutually exclusive with uniqueDataRecords.

uniqueDataRecords.description: One row per key in the active table (classic DSO). Mutually exclusive with snapshotSupport.

mode.description: inboundQueueOnly (default; data stays in AQ, keyless OK, no reporting) | compressDataLog (activates data, no changelog; REQUIRES a key) | corporateMemory (keeps changelog history; server forces reporting on).

reportingEnabled.description: Expose for reporting (isReportingObject). Only valid when mode != inboundQueueOnly.

packageName.description: Target development package. Default $TMP (local object). Requires transport to actually take effect.

transport.description: Workbench request number. When set, the object is created in packageName and recorded in this request (corrNr). Without it the object lands in $TMP.

outputPath.description: If provided, the full result is written to this path (under the workdir) and the tool returns only a small summary envelope { ok, outputPath, bytes, summary }. tools.name: bw_infoobject_create
tools.description: Create an InfoObject (choose iobjType). CHA: CHAR skeleton + PUT (length/description). UNI: currency/unit (CUKY, refs 0CURRENCY by default); $TMP or package+transport. KYF: amount key figure (CURR/AMO/SUM); pass unitInfoObject — POST creates KYF then PUT binds the unit. Real package REQUIRES transport; omit → $TMP. Check verification.persisted.

iobjType.description: CHA = characteristic. UNI = currency/unit. KYF = key figure (amount).

name.description: Technical name, 3-9 chars starting with a letter (e.g. ZC_RWCUR, ZK_AMT).

length.description: CHA only: output length (default 5 via PUT). Ignored for UNI/KYF.

referencedInfoObject.description: UNI only: base unit IOBJ. Default 0CURRENCY for currency units.

unitType.description: UNI only: CUR = currency (CUKY). Default CUR.

objectSpecificDataType.description: KYF only: key figure data type. Default CURR.

unitInfoObject.description: KYF only: currency/unit IOBJ to bind (e.g. ZC_CUR, ZC_RWCUR, 0CURRENCY). Applied on PUT after create — prefer a UNI IOBJ, not bare local fields.

highPrecision.description: KYF only: high precision storage. Default true.

packageName.description: Target development package. Default $TMP (local object). Requires transport to actually take effect.

transport.description: Workbench request number. When set, the object is created in packageName and recorded in this request (corrNr). Without it the object lands in $TMP.
